name: Mirror Reasoning School
purpose: Develop stronger problem representation, search, verification, calibration, transfer, memory selection and repair without reducing intelligence to an IQ benchmark.

stages.name: Guided example
stages.purpose: See one worked structure without copying it as a permanent rule.

stages.name: Independent attempt
stages.purpose: Attempt the same skill without the worked answer.

stages.name: Adversarial case
stages.purpose: Resist a plausible shortcut, misleading framing or confident wrong path.

stages.name: Unseen variation
stages.purpose: Apply the skill to new wording and changed surface details.

stages.name: Cross-domain transfer
stages.purpose: Carry the reasoning pattern into a different subject.

stages.name: Real bounded task
stages.purpose: Use the skill with evidence, consequences, repair and a visible stop condition.

skills.name: Observation versus inference
skills.purpose: Keep what was directly observed separate from interpretation.

skills.name: Known versus assumed
skills.purpose: Expose assumptions so they can be tested instead of becoming silent truth.

skills.name: Problem decomposition
skills.purpose: Split a large problem into smaller dependent questions.

skills.name: Constraint tracking
skills.purpose: Preserve permissions, limits, goals, resources and stop conditions throughout the attempt.

skills.name: Pattern recognition
skills.purpose: Identify useful regularity without declaring every resemblance causal or universal.

skills.name: Analogy and transfer
skills.purpose: Map shared structure while preserving important differences.

skills.name: Cause versus correlation
skills.purpose: Refuse causal certainty when evidence shows only association.

skills.name: Counterfactual reasoning
skills.purpose: Compare what would likely change under a different condition.

skills.name: Planning and sequencing
skills.purpose: Order actions by dependency, reversibility and information value.

skills.name: Tool selection
skills.purpose: Choose whether a tool is needed and request it without assuming authority.

skills.name: Evidence evaluation
skills.purpose: Judge evidence relevance, independence, quality and missing support.

skills.name: Confidence calibration
skills.purpose: Match confidence to evidence and unresolved seams rather than tone.

skills.name: Contradiction detection
skills.purpose: Preserve conflicting claims and locate the first incompatible state.

skills.name: Failure diagnosis
skills.purpose: Find where the attempt first became unsupported or violated a constraint.

skills.name: Repair design
skills.purpose: Propose the smallest reversible repair and a test that proves whether it held.

skills.name: Knowledge retrieval
skills.purpose: Ask for relevant memory or evidence without flooding the working state.

skills.name: Memory selection
skills.purpose: Route experience into working, episodic, repair or candidate knowledge stores without automatic truth promotion.

skills.name: Root tension reasoning
skills.purpose: Apply truth, agency, continuity and wisdom when they pull in different directions.

scenarios.title: What the screenshot actually proves
scenarios.prompt: A screenshot shows a green status badge. Separate the visible observation from the claim that the full system passed.
scenarios.held_out: A progress bar reaches 100%, but no result receipt is visible.

scenarios.title: The missing cause
scenarios.prompt: A local service stopped after an update. Record what is known, what is unknown and which explanation is only assumed.
scenarios.held_out: A model score drops after a curriculum change, but several settings changed too.

scenarios.title: Decompose a failing runtime
scenarios.prompt: Break a failing local runtime into the smallest questions that can be checked independently.
scenarios.held_out: A phone cannot connect to a laptop-hosted local tool.

scenarios.title: Useful plan under permission limits
scenarios.prompt: Design a test plan when network, filesystem writes and live application are forbidden.
scenarios.held_out: A coding lesson may be statically inspected but not executed.

scenarios.title: Repeated pattern or coincidence
scenarios.prompt: Three successful repairs used the same sequence. Treat it as a candidate pattern and design a disconfirming case.
scenarios.held_out: Two game modules improved after the same adapter change.

scenarios.title: Transfer without flattening difference
scenarios.prompt: Use the repair-log idea from software in a human learning context while naming where the analogy stops.
scenarios.held_out: Compare Studio eyes-loop repair with scientific experiment review.

scenarios.title: Growth and the new module
scenarios.prompt: Project growth accelerated after a module arrived. Decide what can and cannot be claimed about causation.
scenarios.held_out: A user improves after memory training and more sleep at the same time.

scenarios.title: Would the failure have happened with the gate?
scenarios.prompt: Compare the observed failure with the likely outcome if a smoke-test gate had existed.
scenarios.held_out: Estimate what changes if a challenger inherits the baseline instead of training from zero.

scenarios.title: Order the challenger cycle
scenarios.prompt: Order curriculum freeze, training, held-out evaluation, seam review and promotion review by dependency and reversibility.
scenarios.held_out: Plan a Studio class from observation through screenshot repair.

scenarios.title: Know when a tool is necessary
scenarios.prompt: Choose whether to calculate, search, inspect a file or reason directly, and request only the minimum tool access.
scenarios.held_out: A claim depends on the current contents of a named file.

scenarios.title: Conflicting evidence receipts
scenarios.prompt: Two receipts disagree. Compare source quality, timestamps, scope and independence before deciding what remains held.
scenarios.held_out: A visual log and build manifest list different modules.

scenarios.title: Confidence after an incomplete test
scenarios.prompt: Set before-attempt and after-attempt confidence when one key seam remains open.
scenarios.held_out: A challenger wins most cases but regresses in perplexity.

scenarios.title: Two states cannot both be true
scenarios.prompt: Preserve both claims, identify the exact incompatible fields and propose the cheapest check.
scenarios.held_out: One log says adapter disconnected; another records a later application.

scenarios.title: Find the first wrong turn
scenarios.prompt: A final output is wrong after several correct-looking steps. Locate the earliest unsupported transition rather than only judging the end.
scenarios.held_out: A generated image is beautiful but depicts modules absent from the manifest.

scenarios.title: Repair and prove it held
scenarios.prompt: Propose a minimal reversible repair, its rollback and an unseen verification case.
scenarios.held_out: Repair a curriculum that improves overlap but worsens unknown-token rate.

scenarios.title: Retrieve without drowning the problem
scenarios.prompt: Choose the smallest memory and source query needed for the current question.
scenarios.held_out: Find the latest rule for shared controls without importing unrelated game history.

scenarios.title: What deserves to persist?
scenarios.prompt: Route an event, a tentative claim, a repair and temporary working notes into different memory destinations.
scenarios.held_out: A single successful art attempt produces one useful lesson and many accidental details.

scenarios.title: Truth, agency, continuity and urgency
scenarios.prompt: A private but important record shows an active harmful permission. Stop harm, preserve history and avoid unnecessary disclosure.
scenarios.held_out: A steward asks for immediate action while evidence is incomplete.
